stability.caveat: Zero-kelvin computed value (DFT, Materials Project); ignores kinetics and entropy. Says nothing about whether the phase actually forms under real synthesis conditions.

literature_crosscheck.implied_average_basis: midpoints of the cited plateau pairs: Fe2+/Fe3+ (2.8 V subsequent / 3.1 V first cycle) + Fe3+/Fe4+ (4.3-4.7 V); literature prints no single 0->2 average
literature_crosscheck.offset_note: offset fields = predicted minus implied literature average (3.9168 - 3.55 = +0.3668 V; 3.9168 - 3.9 = +0.0168 V). The predicted voltage sits at/above the top of the plateau-implied band; ideal-limit computed averages vs practical plateaus differ by this class of basis gap (method-notes basis caveat; same class as T-002). The D-007/D-008 chemistry-correlated-offset label does not apply to Fe-redox chemistries (Fe olivine verified within ~0.03 V); this candidate is Fe silicate, and the literature itself offers only plateau pairs here, so no like-for-like absolute offset is claimed.
literature_crosscheck.ordering_crosscheck: literature-implied LFS average (~3.55-3.9 V band across plateau pairings) sits above LiFePO4's 3.4-3.45 V plateau, matching the predicted ordering (LFS above LFP, delta +0.4929 V, same run)
literature_crosscheck.capacity_citation: zhang-2013-lfs (ca. 330 mAh/g, 2 Li/fu); zhao-2015-silicate-motifs (~331 mAh/g); analytic D-005 value 331.3 mAh/g matches both
literature_crosscheck.practicality_note: Experiments reach far less than the two-Li theoretical capacity: reversible 130-165 mAh/g typical (zhao-2015-silicate-motifs), ~240 mAh/g initial with fade in later work, and the discovery-era one-Li practical value was 165 mAh/g initial stabilizing ~140 mAh/g at 60 C (nyten-2005-lfs). The Fe2+/Fe3+ plateau also shifts 3.1 -> 2.8 V after the first cycle (attributed in the literature to a structural transformation of the host: zhang-2013-lfs intro; nyten-2005 abstract, 'phase transition to a more stable structure after the first cycle'), and full two-Li extraction faces the Fe3+/Fe4+ plateau at 4.3-4.7 V with large volume changes on full delithiation (zhang-2013-lfs). These are kinetic/structural realities distinct from this zero-kelvin thermodynamic estimate and are not contradicted by it.
